brief:
**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, VA, a new countywide fire company was approved with operations starting October 15 to improve coordination among volunteer departments; Grants Supermarket in Richlands closes today after nearly 25 years due to high utility costs averaging $25,000 monthly. A Wind Advisory remains in effect for Tazewell and surrounding counties until 11 a.m. Sunday. In the broader region, high wind warnings affect parts of eastern Tennessee and western North Carolina through early Sunday, with no major law enforcement incidents reported in the core area in the last 24 hours.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)[[2]](https://nypost.com/2026/10/06/business/virginia-supermarket-says-25k-monthly-utility-bills-are-forcing-it-to-close/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** Bluefield, WV Police Department released a bench warrant list (issued by Bluefield City Municipal Court) on or around October 7–9, 2026; individuals can turn themselves in at the department for processing and bond. Names include Deanna Sparks (Bluefield, WV), Jason Earls (Bluefield, WV), and others from the area and beyond; contact 304-327-6101 option 1 to confirm. [OSINT - NEWS][[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-54/)

No other arrests, charges, or major investigations reported in Tazewell County, Richlands, Bluefield VA/WV, or Mercer County in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for larger sheriff, state police, or federal cases touching the area.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Core:** Tazewell County Board of Supervisors unanimously approved the roster for a new countywide fire company at its October meeting to improve coordination, training, and response; the company begins serving unincorporated areas October 15 while existing stations remain in place. [OSINT - NEWS][[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-approves-firefighter-list-new-countywide-department/)

Tazewell County is holding its annual Fire Prevention Parade today (Saturday, October 10) at 6 p.m., starting at Tazewell High School and ending near the fairgrounds. [OSINT - NEWS][[5]](https://woay.com/tazewell-county-celebrating-fire-prevention-month-with-annual-fire-prevention-parade-on-october-10/)

Bluefield, VA and WV fire departments held or are promoting fire safety events and seeking volunteers. [OSINT - NEWS]

**Region:** Vehicle fire on I-77 southbound in Mercer County, WV caused temporary lane closures; lanes reopened (reported October 9). [OSINT - NEWS]

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:** Wind Advisory for Tazewell County, VA (and Smyth, Grayson, Mercer, Summers, Western Greenbrier) until 11 a.m. Sunday, October 11, issued by NWS Blacksburg. Similar advisories cover Buchanan, McDowell, and other nearby counties until 11 a.m. Sunday (NWS Charleston WV). [Free lead / OSINT - WEB]

No flooding, power outages, boil-water notices, or major VDOT/WVDOH closures reported on US-19, US-460, US-52, or I-77 in the core.

**Region:** High Wind Warning for parts of eastern Tennessee (Cherokee, Clay, Johnson, etc.) and western North Carolina until 8 a.m. Sunday (NWS Morristown). [Free lead / OSINT - WEB]

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County School Board public hearing on interim appointment to the Northwestern District seat scheduled for October 12 at 7:15 p.m. at the Career and Technical Center. [OSINT - WEB][[6]](https://wvlegals.com/public-notice-35612/)

**Region:** Nothing new reported in the last 24 hours for state-level actions directly impacting the area.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Grants Supermarket in Richlands (Tazewell County, VA) closes after business today (October 10) after nearly 25 years; owners cited average monthly utility bills exceeding $25,000 and lease expiration. [OSINT - NEWS][[2]](https://nypost.com/2026/10/06/business/virginia-supermarket-says-25k-monthly-utility-bills-are-forcing-it-to-close/)[[7]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/05/grants-supermarket-richlands-closing-after-25-years/)

7 Brew Coffee planned for Mercer County, WV. [OSINT - NEWS]

Bluefield State University professor received $370,000 funding for cancer treatment research. [OSINT - NEWS]

**Region:** Four STEM centers established in McDowell County, WV schools (announced October 9). [OSINT - NEWS]

Virginia’s rising energy demand noted in state discussions. [OSINT - NEWS]

Prescribed burns planned by Monongahela National Forest in two WV counties. [OSINT - NEWS]

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Tazewell County Fire Prevention Parade (today, 6 p.m.).
- Kids Fishing Day, Town of Tazewell (today, Lincolnshire Pool, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.).
- Tazewell County School Board hearing (October 12, 7:15 p.m.).
- Wind Advisory/high wind conditions continue through Sunday morning.
- New Tazewell County fire company begins operations October 15.
